messages.text: What is measurement method, and which product-related measurement decisions depend on understanding it?

“Measurement method” is stated as a test method of “Measurement” in the source text [37].  
Product-related measurement decisions that depend on understanding the method include choosing conducted versus radiated NR base-station conformance testing, because 3GPP TS 38.141 is divided into conducted testing in TS 38.141-1 and radiated testing in TS 38.141-2 [12].  
For conducted NR base-station transmitter tests, the decision includes whether to use Rohde & Schwarz signal or spectrum analyzers in manual or remote-control operation [21].  
For transmitter intermodulation test case 6.7, the decision includes adding an extra signal generator to generate the interferer [21].  
For OTA transmitter or receiver testing, the decision depends on using the separate OTA test coverage referenced by GFM324 and GFM325 [21].  
For high-power base-station measurements, the decision includes using suitable attenuators to avoid damaging test equipment [21].  
For satellite payload group-delay measurement, the decision includes using an R&S FSW spectrum analyzer with an R&S SMW200A signal generator for fast direct absolute and relative group-delay measurements on satellite transponders, frequency converters and other components [26].  
For frequency converters without LO access, especially when conventional methods are limited by DUT internal LO drift or noise, the decision includes using the R&S ZNA vector network analyzer two-tone technique [6].

T319a › UE behavior while T319a running
Ongoing SDT procedure 期間，即 `T319a` running 時，UE：

- 監控與 shared data channel associated 的 control channels，以判斷是否有 data scheduled。
- 不監控 CN paging 與 RAN paging。
- 每個 modification period 至少在任一 paging occasion 監控一次 SI change indication。
- 不 request on-demand SI，包括 `posSIBs`。
- 不為 MDT log measurements。
- 不進行 early measurement report measurements。
- 不執行 RNA update。

來源另補充 Rel-18 extended CG periodicity 情境：若 `T319a` not running、CG-SDT selected、`cg-SDT-PeriodicityExt` configured，UE monitors paging channel for CN paging using `5G-S-TMSI` and RAN paging using `fullI-RNTI`，並在 own paging occasions 監控 SI change indication and PWS notification。

LTM L1 measurement reporting › 支援的 measurement
依 [[L1_L2 Triggered Mobility (LTM)]]：

- UE 對配置的 LTM candidate cell(s) 執行 [[L1 measurement]]，並向 gNB 傳送 [[L1 measurement report]]。
- 只要 LTM configuration 適用，就應執行 L1 measurement。
- candidate cell 支援：
  - [[L1 intra-frequency measurement]]。
  - [[L1 inter-frequency measurement]]。
- 兩種 measurements 都在 candidate cells 的 [[SSB]] 上執行。
- 僅支援對 [[cell defining SSB]]（CD-SSB）的 measurements。
- intra-frequency 與 inter-frequency 的 measurement quantity 都是 [[L1-RSRP]]。
- 未定義 measurement filtering。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 方法二：R&S ZNA two-tone technique
[[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]] 說 [[R&S ZNA]] vector network analyzer 可用於量測 frequency converters without LO access 的 group delay，特別是傳統方法受 DUT internal LO drift / noise 限制時。

R&S ZNA › R&S®ZNA-B15 RFFE GPIO interface 規格摘錄
- Models .02 and .03 提供 two independent MIPI RFFE busses。
- Connector type：25-pin D-Sub，female。
- RFFE port 1 / 2 的 VIO、DATA、CLK 電壓範圍為 0 V to +2 V，1 mV step，maximum current 20 mA。
- CLK configurable clock rate：31.25 kHz to 26 MHz。
- GPIO 1 to GPIO 8：voltage range –5 V to +10 V；typ. –6 V to +12 V；voltage step size 5 mV；maximum current 20 mA。
- GPIO 9 and 10：voltage range –5 V to +10 V；typ. –6 V to +12 V；voltage step size 5 mV；maximum current 100 mA。
- Model .03 提供 voltage and current measurement with switchable source resistance；32 internal ADC channels 可同時量測每個 RFFE 與 GPIO pin 的 voltage and current。

3GPP TS 38.321
[[3GPP TS 38.321]] 是本 vault 用來收納來源中 shorthand `38.321` 的 5G NR MAC layer technical specification 引用頁；[[NR Knowledge Base]] 將其列為 NR Stack relevant specification，題名為 **Medium Access Control (MAC) protocol specification**。目前細節僅由 [[Extended Logical Channel IDs]] 與 [[Satellite switch with resynchronization]] 支撐部分線索，尚未 ingest 正式標準全文。

GFM313_3e_5G_NR_BaseStation_Tx_Tests › 標準與測試範圍
來源說 [[3GPP]] 負責標準化，並在 [[3GPP TS 38.141]] 定義 NR [[Base Station]] RF conformance test methods and requirements，涵蓋：

- transmitter（Tx）
- receiver（Rx）
- performance（Px）

[[3GPP TS 38.141]] 依測試方法分為兩部分：

- [[3GPP TS 38.141-1]] Part 1：Conducted conformance testing。
- [[3GPP TS 38.141-2]] Part 2：Radiated conformance testing。

來源引用的 literature：

- [[3GPP TS 38.141-1]] Release 16 V16.3.0（2020）：NR Base station conformance testing, Part 1: Conducted conformance testing。
- [[3GPP TS 38.141-2]] Release 16 V16.3.0（2020）：NR Base Station conformance testing Part 2: Radiated conformance testing。
- [[3GPP TS 38.104]] Release 16 V16.3.0（2020）：NR Base Station radio transmission and reception。
- Rohde & Schwarz, 5G NR Technology Introduction（2019）。
- Rohde & Schwarz, Remote Control and Instrument Drivers。
- Rohde & Schwarz, Introducing SCPI Commands。

NR Knowledge Base › 重點摘要
[[NR Knowledge Base]] 是一份 Rohde & Schwarz company confidential 的 NR fundamentals 入口頁，定位為尋找 [[5G NR]] features、specific topics、technical notes 與 further details 的 entry point。

來源正文指出此頁只提供 [[Architecture]] 與 [[3GPP Standard]] 相關資訊；R&S specific implementation details 則應在 [[Stack]] 中查找。

來源列出 NR Stack 相關規格，包括：

- [[3GPP TS 38.101]] — User Equipment (UE) radio transmission and reception。
- [[3GPP TS 38.211]]。
- [[3GPP TS 38.212]]。
- [[3GPP TS 38.213]] — Physical layer procedures for control。
- [[3GPP TS 38.214]]。
- [[3GPP TS 38.321]]。
- [[3GPP TS 38.331]]。

來源同頁也列出若干 R&S / 內部知識資源：

- R&S local mirror 中的 specifications PDF versions。
- [[R&S 3GPP standardization group]] / [[R&S 3GPP-Portal]]。
- [[5G PHY Training]]。
- [[5G Forum (JAM)]]。
- [[Global 5G AE Training (JAM)]]。
- [[5G eBook]] via [[GLORIS]]。
- 書籍：Chris Johnson, *5G New Radio in Bullets*, 1st Edition, 2019, ISBN 9781081444594；來源註記可向 Mai Philipp (8DSMS) 借閱。

來源最後提供 proposed subpage structure / TODO，包括 [[Frame Structure]]、[[Frequency Ranges and Bands]]、[[Phase Compensation]]、[[Split Bearer]]、[[Search Spaces]]、[[Statistics]]、[[FDD]]、[[SIB]]、[[Mobility]]、[[Carrier Aggregation]]、[[Physical Channels and Signals]]、[[Scheduling]]、[[DRX]]、[[Beams]]、[[BWP operation]]、[[Timing Alignment Groups]] 與 [[OTA]]。

T319a
[[T319a]] 是 [[Small Data Transmission (SDT)]] procedure 的 failure detection timer；來源指出 [[T319a]] running 表示 SDT procedure running，且 SDT 不使用 legacy [[T319]]。

LTM L1 measurement reporting
[[LTM L1 measurement reporting]] 是 [[L1-L2 Triggered Mobility]] 中 UE 對 [[LTM candidate cell]] 執行 L1 measurement 並向 gNB 回報的機制，用於支援 gNB 以 L1 / L2 觸發 cell switch。[[L1_L2 Triggered Mobility (LTM)]]

衛星酬載群延遲量測
[[衛星酬載群延遲量測]]是用來判定 satellite communications transmission path phase distortions、frequency converter / transponder channel band edge distortion 與 transmission path quality 的測試方法集合。

3GPP TS 38.321 › NR Stack 索引中的定位

GFM313_3e_5G_NR_BaseStation_Tx_Tests › 重點摘要
- 文件名稱：`5G New Radio Conducted Base Station Transmitter Tests according to TS 38.141-1, Rel. 16`。
- 文件類型：Rohde & Schwarz Application Note。
- 文件代號：`GFM313`。
- 版本：`3e`。
- 日期：`01.2021`。
- 作者：Christian Wicke、Bernhard Schulz、Fabian Bette。
- 文件網址：`https://www.rohde-schwarz.com/appnote/GFM313`。
- 文件範圍：依 [[3GPP TS 38.141-1]] Release 16 V16.3.0 chapter 6 執行所有 mandatory RF transmitter tests。
- 文件只涵蓋 [[single carrier]]（SC）tests 與 conducted measurements。
- [[3GPP TS 38.141-1]] chapter 7 receiver tests 由 [[GFM314]] 說明；chapter 8 performance tests 由 [[GFM315]] 說明。
- OTA transmitter / receiver tests 分別指向 [[GFM324]] 與 [[GFM325]]。
- 測試可用 Rohde & Schwarz signal 或 spectrum analyzers，以 manual operation 或 remote control approach 執行。
- 其中 [[Transmitter intermodulation]] test case 6.7 需要額外 signal generator 產生 interferer。
- 來源附帶 software libraries / Python package / QuickStep testmodules，示範 remote-control approach；software 以 `as is` 形式提供。
- 安全注意事項：base stations 可能產生非常高的 output powers，需使用合適 attenuators 以避免 test equipment 損壞。

NR Knowledge Base › 與既有知識的關係
- 既有 [[3GPP TS 38.211]]、[[3GPP TS 38.212]]、[[3GPP TS 38.213]]、[[3GPP TS 38.214]]、[[3GPP TS 38.321]] 已保存各自由 feature notes 引用的 section / table 線索；本來源提供的是更上層的 NR Stack specification index。

T319a › 定義
依 [[Small Data Transmission (SDT)]]：

- `T319a` 是 new timer，在 SDT procedure initiated 時啟動。
- `T319a` 是 [[MO-SDT]] 與 [[MT-SDT]] 的 SDT failure detection timer。
- `T319a` 由 network 在 [[SIB1]] configured。
- `T319a` running 表示 SDT procedure running。
- `T319a` 不會因 subsequent data transmission 而 restart。

- candidate cell 的 [[CSI-RS]] 未在 [[Release 18]] 指定。

這補充 [[CSI-RS]] 頁：在 LTM candidate cell measurement context 中，Release 18 不支援 candidate cell CSI-RS measurement。[[L1_L2 Triggered Mobility (LTM)]]

SUL RACH initial access procedure › Msg1：carrier selection
依 [[SUL RACH procedure]] 對 [[3GPP TS 38.321]] Section 5.1.1 與 [[3GPP TS 38.331]] 的摘錄，initial [[Msg1]] / [[PRACH]] carrier selection 可整理為：

1. 若 carrier to use for the [[Random Access procedure]] is explicitly signalled：
   - UE selects the signalled carrier for performing Random Access procedure。
2. 否則，若 serving cell for the Random Access procedure configured with supplementary uplink，且 [[RSRP]] of downlink pathloss reference is less than `rsrp-ThresholdSSB-SUL`：
   - UE selects the [[SUL carrier]] for performing Random Access procedure。
3. 否則：
   - UE selects the [[Normal Uplink carrier]] for performing Random Access procedure。

answer.text:
“Measurement method” is stated as a test method of “Measurement” in the source text [37].  
Product-related measurement decisions that depend on understanding the method include choosing conducted versus radiated NR base-station conformance testing, because 3GPP TS 38.141 is divided into conducted testing in TS 38.141-1 and radiated testing in TS 38.141-2 [12].  
For conducted NR base-station transmitter tests, the decision includes whether to use Rohde & Schwarz signal or spectrum analyzers in manual or remote-control operation [21].  
For transmitter intermodulation test case 6.7, the decision includes adding an extra signal generator to generate the interferer [21].  
For OTA transmitter or receiver testing, the decision depends on using the separate OTA test coverage referenced by GFM324 and GFM325 [21].  
For high-power base-station measurements, the decision includes using suitable attenuators to avoid damaging test equipment [21].  
For satellite payload group-delay measurement, the decision includes using an R&S FSW spectrum analyzer with an R&S SMW200A signal generator for fast direct absolute and relative group-delay measurements on satellite transponders, frequency converters and other components [26].  
For frequency converters without LO access, especially when conventional methods are limited by DUT internal LO drift or noise, the decision includes using the R&S ZNA vector network analyzer two-tone technique [6].

GFM313_3e_5G_NR_BaseStation_Tx_Tests › 標準與測試範圍
來源說 [[3GPP]] 負責標準化，並在 [[3GPP TS 38.141]] 定義 NR [[Base Station]] RF conformance test methods and requirements，涵蓋：

- transmitter（Tx）
- receiver（Rx）
- performance（Px）

[[3GPP TS 38.141]] 依測試方法分為兩部分：

- [[3GPP TS 38.141-1]] Part 1：Conducted conformance testing。
- [[3GPP TS 38.141-2]] Part 2：Radiated conformance testing。

來源引用的 literature：

- [[3GPP TS 38.141-1]] Release 16 V16.3.0（2020）：NR Base station conformance testing, Part 1: Conducted conformance testing。
- [[3GPP TS 38.141-2]] Release 16 V16.3.0（2020）：NR Base Station conformance testing Part 2: Radiated conformance testing。
- [[3GPP TS 38.104]] Release 16 V16.3.0（2020）：NR Base Station radio transmission and reception。
- Rohde & Schwarz, 5G NR Technology Introduction（2019）。
- Rohde & Schwarz, Remote Control and Instrument Drivers。
- Rohde & Schwarz, Introducing SCPI Commands。

GFM313_3e_5G_NR_BaseStation_Tx_Tests › 重點摘要
- 文件名稱：`5G New Radio Conducted Base Station Transmitter Tests according to TS 38.141-1, Rel. 16`。
- 文件類型：Rohde & Schwarz Application Note。
- 文件代號：`GFM313`。
- 版本：`3e`。
- 日期：`01.2021`。
- 作者：Christian Wicke、Bernhard Schulz、Fabian Bette。
- 文件網址：`https://www.rohde-schwarz.com/appnote/GFM313`。
- 文件範圍：依 [[3GPP TS 38.141-1]] Release 16 V16.3.0 chapter 6 執行所有 mandatory RF transmitter tests。
- 文件只涵蓋 [[single carrier]]（SC）tests 與 conducted measurements。
- [[3GPP TS 38.141-1]] chapter 7 receiver tests 由 [[GFM314]] 說明；chapter 8 performance tests 由 [[GFM315]] 說明。
- OTA transmitter / receiver tests 分別指向 [[GFM324]] 與 [[GFM325]]。
- 測試可用 Rohde & Schwarz signal 或 spectrum analyzers，以 manual operation 或 remote control approach 執行。
- 其中 [[Transmitter intermodulation]] test case 6.7 需要額外 signal generator 產生 interferer。
- 來源附帶 software libraries / Python package / QuickStep testmodules，示範 remote-control approach；software 以 `as is` 形式提供。
- 安全注意事項：base stations 可能產生非常高的 output powers，需使用合適 attenuators 以避免 test equipment 損壞。
